<js>

let lists = java.getElements("#continusRead||#reader-btn");
let data=[];
if (String(lists)) {
    for (var i = 0; i < lists.length; i++) {
        let url = String(lists[i].select("a").attr("href")).replace(/-[^-]*-/g, '-webp-');
        let uri = `${getUrl()}${url}`;
        data.push({
            title: lists[i].select("a").text(),
            href:`data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(uri)},{"type":"辞晨"}`
});
}}else{
	//执行书架，没有详细书籍

let ido=java.base64Decode(getid);
let id=String(ido).match(/\-(\d+)\./)?.[1]||1;
//let url=`${getUrl()}/photos-webp-aid-${id}.html`;
let url=`${getUrl()}/photos-item-aid-${id}.html`;
data.push({
title:"单章节",
href:`data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(url)},{"type":"辞晨"}`
});
	}
	data;
</js>
